name: AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce
author: aicoso

sections.description:
AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce is a WordPress wishlist plugin that lets shoppers save WooCommerce products for later and return to them when they are ready.

Customers can build product wishlists while browsing your store, including as guest visitors. Registered customers can organize saved products into multiple wishlists, share lists with other people, save specific product variations, and add saved items directly to the WooCommerce cart.

For store owners, AICOSO Wishlist also provides wishlist notifications and analytics for understanding interest in saved products.

What is a WooCommerce wishlist?

A WooCommerce wishlist gives shoppers a place to save products they are interested in without adding them to the cart immediately.

Wishlists are useful when customers want to:

  • Save products for a future purchase
  • Compare products before deciding
  • Keep track of favorite products
  • Save a particular size, color, or other product variation
  • Plan gifts or purchases for an occasion
  • Share product ideas with friends or family
  • Return to products on a later visit

AICOSO Wishlist adds this save-for-later workflow to WooCommerce.

Wishlist Features

Add Products to a Wishlist

Shoppers can save products using an Add to Wishlist action. AJAX interactions allow wishlist actions to take place without requiring a full page reload.

Guest Wishlist Support

Visitors can save products without first creating a WordPress account.

Guest wishlist functionality gives shoppers a way to keep products for later while they browse. Guest wishlist information can be associated with the customer when they register.

Multiple Wishlists

Registered customers can create and manage multiple wishlists.

Multiple lists can help shoppers organize products for different purposes, such as gift ideas, future purchases, projects, events, or separate groups of products.

Wishlist Sharing

Customers can share wishlists through a direct link or supported social-sharing options.

Shared wishlists can be useful for gift lists, product recommendations, family purchases, or situations where another person is involved in a buying decision.

Variable Product Support

AICOSO Wishlist supports WooCommerce variable products.

When a shopper selects a variation, such as a size, color, or other available product attribute, the selected product variation can be saved with the wishlist item.

Add Wishlist Products to the Cart

Customers can add saved products to the WooCommerce cart directly from their wishlist.

This gives shoppers a straightforward path from saving a product to purchasing it later.

Price-Drop Notifications

The plugin includes price-drop notifications for products saved to wishlists.

These notifications can help customers discover when a product they already saved has gone on sale.

Wishlist Reminder Emails

AICOSO Wishlist includes reminder emails for saved wishlist products.

Reminder emails provide customers with another way to return to products they previously saved.

Wishlist Analytics

Store owners can use the wishlist analytics functionality to review interest in saved products and identify products that shoppers add to wishlists.

Wishlist data can provide additional context about customer product interest alongside normal WooCommerce store data.

WooCommerce Blocks Support

AICOSO Wishlist includes compatibility with WooCommerce Blocks as documented for the current plugin release.

Responsive Wishlist Experience

Wishlist interfaces are designed for use across desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.

Common WooCommerce Wishlist Use Cases

A wishlist can support several shopping workflows.

  • Save for later – Shoppers can keep products without adding them to the cart immediately.
  • Product comparison – Customers can collect products they want to compare before purchasing.
  • Favorite products – Visitors can keep a list of products they want to revisit.
  • Gift lists – Customers can organize and share products for birthdays, holidays, and other occasions.
  • Variable products – Shoppers can save the selected variation of a WooCommerce product.
  • Shopping planning – Customers can create separate wishlists for different future purchases.
  • Shared decisions – A wishlist link can be shared with another person before a purchase is made.
  • Return visits – Saved products give shoppers a direct way to find products they previously selected.

Privacy

AICOSO Wishlist requires wishlist information to provide saved-product functionality.

Wishlist information for registered customers is stored within the WordPress site. Guest wishlist functionality may use cookies or temporary browser/session information so saved products can persist during the guest shopping experience.

When a customer voluntarily uses a social-sharing feature, the selected sharing service may receive information necessary to perform that action according to that service’s own privacy practices.

Website owners are responsible for evaluating their complete WordPress and WooCommerce configuration, privacy notices, consent requirements, retention policies, and applicable legal obligations.

Support

For help with AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce, use the plugin’s WordPress.org support forum.

Additional product information and support resources are available at:
https://aicoso.com/support

When requesting support, include your WordPress version, WooCommerce version, plugin version, theme, relevant extensions, and the steps needed to reproduce the issue where possible.
sections.installation:
Install from the WordPress Dashboard

  1. In your WordPress admin area, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “AICOSO Wishlist”.
  3. Select AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin.
  6. Review the plugin settings and configure the wishlist experience for your store.

WooCommerce must be installed and active for WooCommerce-specific wishlist functionality.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Activate AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce.
  6. Review the available wishlist settings.

FTP Installation

  1. Extract the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the aicoso-wishlist-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  4. Review the wishlist settings.
sections.faq:
What is a WooCommerce wishlist plugin?

A WooCommerce wishlist plugin lets customers save products they are interested in so they can find them again later. Depending on the available features, customers may also organize saved products, share wishlists, save product variations, and add wishlist items to the cart.

AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce provides this functionality for WordPress stores using WooCommerce.

How do I add a wishlist to WooCommerce?

Install and activate AICOSO Wishlist for WooCommerce from the WordPress plugin directory or upload the plugin manually.

After activation, review the plugin settings and configure the wishlist functionality for your WooCommerce store.

Can WooCommerce customers save products for later?

Yes. AICOSO Wishlist lets shoppers save WooCommerce products to a wishlist so they can return to them later.

Can guests use the WooCommerce wishlist?

Yes. Guest visitors can save products without creating an account first.

Guest wishlist information can later be associated with the shopper when they register.

Can registered customers create multiple wishlists?

Yes. Registered customers can create and manage multiple wishlists to organize saved products for different purposes.

Can customers share their WooCommerce wishlist?

Yes. Wishlists can be shared using a direct link and supported social-sharing options.

Does the wishlist support WooCommerce variable products?

Yes. Customers can save selected WooCommerce product variations, including available attributes such as size or color.

Can customers add wishlist products directly to the cart?

Yes. Products can be added to the WooCommerce cart from the wishlist.

Does AICOSO Wishlist support WooCommerce Blocks?

WooCommerce Blocks compatibility is included in the current AICOSO Wishlist release.

Because WordPress, WooCommerce, themes, blocks, and extensions change over time, test important store workflows in a staging environment when making major updates.

How do wishlist price-drop notifications work?

AICOSO Wishlist includes price-drop notifications for saved products. These notifications can inform customers when a product they have saved goes on sale.

Does the plugin include wishlist reminder emails?

Yes. The plugin includes reminder-email functionality for wishlist products.

Does the plugin provide wishlist analytics?

Yes. The plugin includes an analytics dashboard for reviewing wishlist activity and interest in saved products.

Where is wishlist information stored?

Wishlist information is stored in your WordPress environment.

Guest wishlist functionality may use browser cookies or temporary browser/session information to maintain a shopper’s wishlist before registration.

Is AICOSO Wishlist GDPR compliant?

Privacy and data-protection compliance depends on the complete configuration of your website, the services you use, your legal obligations, and how you process personal information.

AICOSO Wishlist stores wishlist information for its functionality, and guest wishlist functionality may use cookies or temporary browser/session data. When customers voluntarily use a social-sharing feature, information required for that action may be handled by the selected third-party service.

Site owners should document applicable wishlist data and cookies in their own privacy information where required and review their site’s configuration for the jurisdictions in which they operate.

Does the plugin work with every WooCommerce theme and extension?

AICOSO Wishlist is designed for WooCommerce stores, but WordPress themes and WooCommerce extensions can change templates, product interfaces, AJAX behavior, and other frontend functionality.

For stores with heavily customized themes or complex extension stacks, test wishlist workflows in a staging environment before deploying major changes to production.
